name: ratelimit
summary: Opt-in per-client HTTP rate limit: an in-memory token bucket per client address with a bounded client set, X-Forwarded-For read only from configured trusted proxies, 429 responses with Retry-After, and typed rate_limit configuration. Installing it limits nothing until you add httpserver.RateLimitMiddleware to the chain in internal/httpserver/middleware.go.
postInstall: ratelimit limits nothing yet: add httpserver.RateLimitMiddleware(cfg) to the list middlewareChain returns in internal/httpserver/middleware.go (see internal/ratelimit/README.md), and set rate_limit.trusted_proxies in config.yml when the service runs behind a reverse proxy.
